%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Common Commands and Settings
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Don't use the silly (sub)sub- prefixes on cross-references
\renewcommand{\sectionautorefname}{Section}
\renewcommand{\subsectionautorefname}{Section}
\renewcommand{\subsubsectionautorefname}{Section}

% The below commands color the "Figure", "Algorithm", and "Table" caption prefixes
\definecolor{figurecolor}{RGB}{22,90,220}
\definecolor{citecolor}{RGB}{198,81,19}
\definecolor{href_color}{rgb}{0.0, 0.0, 1.0}%added by Me
\captionsetup[figure]{labelfont={color=figurecolor}}
\captionsetup[table]{labelfont={color=figurecolor}}
\captionsetup[algorithm]{labelfont={color=figurecolor}}


%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Color definitons and useful macros
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\newcommand{\project}{Flexograph} %Because we don't know what to call this project.
\newcommand{\wt}{WiredTiger} %we use this often enough to make a macro for it
\newcommand{\api}{GraphAPI} %tedious to write out

% \newcommand{\code}[1]{\lstinline[style=cpp,basicstyle=\normalsize\ttfamily]$#1$}
\newcommand{\code}[1]{\lstinline[basicstyle=\small\ttfamily]$#1$}
\newcommand{\apicall}[1]{\lstinline[style=cpp,basicstyle=\tiny\ttfamily]$#1$}
\newcommand{\unix}[1]{\texttt{\footnotesize #1}}

%for highlighting a line in the pseudocode
\definecolor{algopink}{rgb}{0.9, 0.56, 0.67}
\definecolor{algoblue}{rgb}{0.45, 0.66, 0.76}
\definecolor{algomid}{rgb}{0.98, 0.81, 0.69}

\newcommand{\highlightP}[1]{\colorbox{algopink}{#1}} % Define a command for highlighting
\newcommand{\highlightB}[1]{\colorbox{algoblue}{#1}} % Define a command for highlighting
\newcommand{\highlightM}[1]{\colorbox{algomid}{#1}} % Define a command for highlighting

\newcommand{\preliminary}[1]{\textbf{\textcolor{red}{#1}}}

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% to make autoref work with algorithms
\providecommand*{\algorithmautorefname}{Algorithm}

\linepenalty=1000
